entity.summary: Argentina-origin custodial cryptocurrency trading and financial-services platform founded in 2014, offering fiat-to-crypto purchase and sale, crypto conversion, deposits, withdrawals, and app-based services across several Latin American markets.
entity.notes: First-party company history states that Satoshi Tango was founded in 2014, but does not establish an exact day; January 1 is used as a year-level marker. The current site exposes registration and active purchase, sale, conversion, deposit, withdrawal, and app functions and identifies Fintech S.A. as registered under number 4 in Argentina's virtual-asset service provider registry. No broader regulatory endorsement is inferred from the registration statement.
